notes.title: tERRORbane's LANGUAGE UPDATE is available! DISCOUNT upcoming for the TGS!
notes.content:
It's finally here!
tERRORbane's LANGUAGE UPDATE is now available for play!

In it you will find:

 New Japanese voice over option for the Developer, featuring Tomokazu Sugita! 
 New Chinese and Italian voice over options for the Developer character.
 New Russian and Traditional Chinese text localizations.
 A new additional shortcut to the WARP ZONE that enables players to reach the casino underground stealth section directly.
 Rebalanced bug objectives for each Bug List section that unlocks the True End.
 Added visual indicators each time a player unlocks a new Bug List section for the first time.
 Added visual indicators to the Bug List to point out dependencies in unlocking each level.
 Minor text changes to the Japanese localization.
 Minor bug and technical fixes.


Stay tuned for an upcoming discount to celebrate our presence at Tokyo Game Show!

The discount and the update will be released on Nintendo Switch in the following days during TGS.

So what are you waiting for? Go out there and catch some internationally charged bug!
The BitNine Studio Team

notes.title: LANGUAGE UPDATE!
notes.content:
SUMMER! 
The season of simmering GPUs and malfunctioning CPUs, did you have fun?

We certainly hope you did! So much so, in fact, that we have prepared a fitting gift to welcome you back to the world of TB after your very well-earned vacations...


Cue in the tERRORbane LANGUAGE UPDATE!

In this upcoming free update our top of the line voice engineers (It's actually us, but imagine us with a lab coat or something.) have selected the finest of voice-over artists to provide their talent to the game:

It is with immense pleasure that I present you the new official Japanese voice of the Developer: Mr. Tomokazu Sugita (杉田 智和)!
Many of you will remember him for his incredibly influential roles in Anime and Videogames, like Gintoki in Gintama or Ragna The Bloodedge in BlazBlue. Did I mention we're big fans?

We'll also have the incredible talent of Sen Zhong-Ren (森中人) as the Chinese voice of the Dev, and Yours Truly (Andrea Leoni) nagging you again as the Italian voice-over option for our favourite computer genius/disaster.

Russian and Traditional Chinese players will also be able to enjoy the game in their preferred text language.

Our top of the line gameplay experts (Yup, still us three. Imagine us with taped-up nerd glasses this time.) also included a complete rebalancing of the gameplay objectives to make achieving the True Ending that much more enjoyable, as well as some new visual aids to help understand your place and progression in the world of tERRORbane better.
Oh, and a new door that will bring you directly to the casino stealth section through the WARP ZONE. ;)


Look forward to the upcoming patch launching right on time for this year's Tokyo Game Show, on all our supported platforms!

notes.title: v1.0.5
notes.content:
Fixed an issue that would cause the Dev to type the name "Terrorbane" in the name selection box for reactions that would ask the player to input the name again.
 Fixed a bug that prevented Japanese players from reading the intro cutscene dialogue in the casino underground stealth section, in The Resistance.
 Adjusted some colliders that could cause players to get out of bounds throughout the game.
 Fixed an issue that would cause the voice over to get desynchronized with the text for the Developer, in the Italian language.
 Optimized the number of accesses to memory throughout the game.
 Fixed minor typos in text and dialogues.

notes.title: v1.0.3
notes.content:
Fixed a bug causing problems to the save file and the main menu after finishing the game and unlocking the Warp Zone.
 Adjusted some colliders that could cause the player to get stuck in The Scrolls
 Fixed an issue with the German description of the Prophecy 2 item that could cause players to not know how to proceed, in Deadburg.
 Fixed some general minor typos in Japanese.

notes.title: "tERRORbane: an INTRODUCTION, mostly" launch!
notes.content:
Hey Folks! 
Have you been trying our demo?
Have you ever wanted to give us and other Steam users feedback about it?
 
The Developer came up with a plan for you to be able to do just that! 

On the 13th of October we will launch the current demo as a separate product titled “tERRORbane: an INTRODUCTION, mostly” so you can leave reviews, rate the experience and create guides for the community! 
This, unfortunately, also means that we'll be discontinuing the demo and removing it from our page. If you have already played it, you will have to download it again and start a new game… 

...but wait right there, you can keep your saved data if you want! You can follow these simple instructions to migrate your save data to the new application:

Step 1
locate your saved data folder in "C:\Users\\AppData\LocalLow\BitNine Studio\tERRORbane - Demo" and make a backup of the data1.bns and data2.bns files you find inside.
Step 2
When the new product releases and you'll have it installed in your computer go to "C:\Users\\AppData\LocalLow\BitNine Studio\tERRORbane - an Introduction, mostly" and replace the files inside with your backed up copy from step 1.

And there it is! You can resume your Demo adventure right where you left it.

ATTENTION! If you have files in you computer from older versions of the demo that did not have the new Chinese and Japanese translations, in some rare cases you may have trouble with your data if you now want to switch to another localization.
If you've been playing in a language but now wish to switch to a new one we highly recommend to start a fresh new game.

While you wait for the release of the full game, have fun with “tERRORbane: an INTRODUCTION, mostly” and let us know what you think about it!

Here is the link: tERRORbane: an INTRODUCTION, mostly
